friendlySummary: On today's GitHub Trending list, this repository gained about 1,395 stars. It has about 10,800 stars in total, and an MIT license. It is a set of written instructions for coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex. Right now it contains one instruction pack, for designing a landing page.
whyItMatters: The skill walks an agent through intake questions, page structure, conversion copy, and a visual system for type, spacing, radius, and motion. You copy the skill folder into the rules path your tool already reads, then ask in plain language for a landing page. Fonts, colors, and motion sit in one section near the bottom of the file, so a fork can change the look without rewriting the steps. It is a checklist for the agent, not a hosted page builder.
